findings: Cyrillic200% instructions now have readable preferred width and controls wrap instead of collapsing text to one character per line.
Templates keep item role/edit/remove context and wrapped long names; editor toolbar wraps and code remains within page; slash lists remain inside short viewport.
FAQ stays in three groups with native disclosure controls; eight native320 images show readable questions/first answer with wrapping.

Source template-card screenshot scrollIntoView moves the sticky shell across the crop; full-page screenshots provide layout context. Fixed mobile navigation appears at viewport boundary inside full-page composites.
200% changes actual typography tokens.360x225 is CSS reflow equivalence for1440x900 at400%, not actual browser zoom.

Thirty current functional captures have explicit native original/detail review across three engines: create/toggle/delete refusal, incoming dirty draft, peer conflict, saved callout, dismissed mention, short slash, contextual tooltip and template empty state.

The prior rename Saved toast is still visible in some immediate refusal captures; the scoped current-action alert and independent persisted reads establish the failed attempt. Previously closing Edit tooltip can briefly overlap Remove during crossfade; exact-name assertions passed.
Full-page short-slash images include fixed-shell compositing effects. Actual popup bounding boxes were asserted before capture; the visual matrix uses viewport popup captures.

Current 768x600 doubled-text sheets expose shared-sidebar Uzbek Inbox text/count overlap and a final username character on its own line. Reported to parent; outside knowledge ownership and not counted repaired.
